title: Synesthete's Dream
description: A fontpack that assigns random colors to each character and introduces the Sleek Font.
body:
This fontpack adds a somewhat modern font with a slightly unique color for each letter and number. The colors are random and are mostly shades of blue, red and yellow.

This font is based on my [Sleek DR](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/sleek-dr) font.
